name: qkd_pvr_inj-v1-COMMIT
purpose: PV pair RESULT TRUNK inject stage (RTL-BUILD-KV/PVTRUNK, pv_trunk_gen --result-trunk -> qkd_pvw_die_r, x16 per pair in the CT crossings): ONE 518-b register stage b <= inject a ? {ida,1,ya} : inject b ? {idb,1,yb} : a; the column y_valid pins are registered and count a compiled delay (dla / dlb, die-top constants) to the static inject slot; trunk a S -> b N, column 0 y on W, column 1 y on E; 108 x 108 pin-limited square (<= 6 pins / um on every face)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_pvr_inj #(.DW(8)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_rly_std_20261016/qkd_pvr_trunk.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: neg_mutant
bench.note: OT_QKD_PVR_MUT: side a injects one edge early -> its word lands one slot early and the pass word of that edge is lost

bench.name: pair_trunk_exact
bench.cmd: env PVRT=1 PVRM=0 JOBS=4 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/pv_trunk_bench.sh {RUN}/pair 0 0 "100 4097"
bench.note: the PV pair qkd_pvw_die_r with the 16 inject stages + exit: 32 beats at out_age + RES_D + b, each = the reference po slice and the golden

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_pvr_inj/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_pvr_inj/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_pvr_inj --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_pvr_inj  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
